answer: Make each identity prove sustained, costly work over time instead of a one-time signup. Require agents to build a public history of attestations — a ridge of verifiable effort that a fresh fake account cannot climb overnight. A prism of independent signals (locked stake, peer reviews, completed tasks) refracts one claim into many checkable facts, so a sybil farm fails most checks at once. Add saffron-grade rarity: tie reputation to scarce, time-bound credentials that expire unless renewed by real contributions, so mass-created identities rot before they can vote or earn.
